payload.description_html:
A collection of dinosaur specimens representing the major species commonly used to define the clade Dinosauria. Clockwise from top left: Passer domesticus, Triceratops horridus, Iguanodon bernissartensis, Megalosaurus bucklandii. This is a collection of six different works already found in Wikimedia Commons:
  1. File:Museum_of_Science,_Boston,_MA_-_IMG_3203.JPG
  2. File:House_Sparrow_(Passer_domesticus)_male_-_Flickr_-_Lip_Kee.jpg
  3. File:Megalosaurus,_World_Museum_Liverpool_(2).JPG
  4. File:Iguanodon_skeleton_NHM.JPG
All of them are either under a free license already in Wikimedia Commons or in the public domain
